blocks.text: Glaiza De Castro reflected on her and her Irish businessman husband David Rainey’s wins in life, including her pregnancy with their first child, which was one of the wishes they made back in 2025. De Castro expressed her gratitude during the celebration of their fifth wedding anniversary, through her Instagram page on Monday, Oct. 12. The post included a photo of a wish they wrote on a paper while they were on a vacation in Japan last year. “Gusto kami ang bata…siguro dalawa,” the note read, with the actress saying it was Rainey who constructed the muddled Filipino sentence. “This year we […]...
